title: XP Repair HUD
description: Displays XP gain and Mending repair progress in a clean HUD overlay.
body:
# Gain XP

A lightweight client-side Fabric mod that displays experience gained in real time using Minecraft's action bar.

## Why does this mod exist?

Minecraft provides experience orbs and level progression, but it doesn't clearly show how much XP you receive from different activities.

Gain XP was created to provide simple and accurate XP notifications without adding extra HUD elements or requiring server-side installation.

## Features

* Displays XP gained in real time
* Supports all vanilla XP sources
* Compatible with Clumps and merged XP orbs
* Lightweight and client-side only
* Works on servers without requiring installation

## Mending Repair

Gain XP also includes Mending Repair notifications.

When an item is repaired by the Mending enchantment, the mod displays the amount of durability restored along with the item's current durability.

### Features

* Displays durability restored by Mending
* Supports repairing multiple items at once
* Shows current and maximum durability
* Real-time action bar notifications
* Lightweight and client-side only
